vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command (OS command injection) vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary system commands.

vulnerabilities.product: Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation of specified type of input vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication and perform actions with administrative privileges via a specially crafted authentication token containing an empty JSON object.

Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands using pre-staged malicious content.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Path Traversal Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains a path traversal vulnerability that could allow an attacker to access and read underlying server system files via the XML interface.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper input validation vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to run arbitrary commands on the affected system.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series Improper Authentication Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Danfoss AK-SM 800A Series contains an improper authentication vulnerability that could allow an attacker to generate a web report exposing sensitive information, including internal IP addresses, usernames, and store names.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains a not failing securely vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication controls and perform unauthorized actions.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component due to insufficient file type validation that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to upload arbitrary files.

Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication vulnerability in the Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV) component that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to access sensitive information using a specific system-generated random identifier or pre-staged content.
